title: Peripheral nerve
subtitle: Oblique section showing fascicles and their envelopes
description: An idealised peripheral nerve in oblique section contains several fascicles within the epineurium. Each fascicle is bounded by perineurium and contains illustrated myelinated fibres and endoneurial supporting tissue.
caption: Illustrative nerve section. Fascicle and fibre counts are arbitrary; unmyelinated fibres are omitted. Not a quantitative histological section.
reference_line: Anatomical reference: OpenStax, Anatomy and Physiology 2e, section 13.4.
